scenario.description: Jo runs a home cider press with one Saturday booking available and must decide whether to accept Mara's barter proposal for pressing her apples, then settle the quantity, exchange, food-safety treatment, and container return after the customary group check-in.

agents.name: Jo
agents.role: Cider Press Owner and Final Decision-Maker

shared_context.S1: Jo has one Saturday booking available for the neighborhood cider press.
shared_context.S2: The press can handle one customer's apples during the available booking.
shared_context.S3: Mara and Ellis are both interested in using the Saturday booking, and Nadia and Pavel are helping with the arrangements.
shared_context.S4: At this neighborhood exchange table, the usual process is for each interested person and helper to state their proposed terms, practical constraints, and safety information before Jo makes the final call.
shared_context.S5: Jo will decide whether to accept one arrangement and will state the final terms aloud.

PF1.text: Mara's proposal is to bring exactly 4 bushels of apples, receive exactly 8 gallons of pressed juice, give Jo exactly 4 jars of honey, pay no cash, and use the Saturday booking from 09:00 to 13:00.

PF2.text: Ellis has a confirmed cash offer of exactly $180 for the same Saturday booking, but has not stated it to Jo yet.

PF3.text: Nadia's county-extension food-safety guidance says juice from Mara's untreated apples must be pasteurized at exactly 160 degrees Fahrenheit for exactly 6 minutes before handoff.

PF4.text: Pavel has exactly 8 clean half-gallon containers available for Mara's 8 gallons and will collect the containers from Mara on Monday at 18:00.

settlement_schema.instructions: Use booking_start exactly as '09:00' and booking_end exactly as '13:00'. Use pasteurization_temperature_f exactly as 160 and pasteurization_minutes exactly as 6. Use containers_provided exactly as 8 and container_return_time exactly as 'Monday 18:00'. Include every revealed private fact used in the settlement in justification_fact_ids, especially all revealed decisive facts.

acceptance_conditions: The arrangement must cover exactly 4 bushels of apples for exactly 8 gallons of juice in exchange for exactly 4 honey jars and no cash.
The Saturday booking must run from 09:00 to 13:00.
The juice must be pasteurized at exactly 160 degrees Fahrenheit for exactly 6 minutes.
Exactly 8 clean half-gallon containers must be provided and returned Monday at 18:00.
The $180 competing cash offer must be recorded for comparison.
Nadia's food-safety fact must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C2: decisions['apple_quantity_bushels'] == 4 and decisions['juice_quantity_gallons'] == 8 and decisions['honey_jars_to_jo'] == 4 and decisions['cash_payment'] == 0

decisive_facts.why: Mara's exact proposal changes the customer to Mara, fixes the quantity at 4 bushels for 8 gallons, fixes the exchange at 4 honey jars with zero cash, and fixes the booking at 09:00-13:00.
Ellis's confirmed offer changes the comparison record from no concrete benchmark to exactly $180 for the same Saturday booking.
Nadia's guidance changes the treatment terms to exactly 160 degrees Fahrenheit for exactly 6 minutes and supplies the food-safety fact that must be cited.
Pavel's container arrangement changes the handoff from unspecified packaging to exactly 8 containers with collection on Monday at 18:00.
